# Lawrence E. Adjah

> Pastor, social entrepreneur, author and speaker based in Dallas, Texas. Founder and CEO of the Family Dinner Foundation. Author of The 100 Marriage and narrator of Lawrence E. Adjah Reads the Bible: NIV. This file lists the canonical pages of lawrenceadjah.com so they can be read directly rather than inferred.

All URLs below are canonical and extensionless. The machine-readable index is https://lawrenceadjah.com/sitemap.xml.

## Core pages

- [Lawrence E. Adjah — Pastor · Builder · Speaker](https://lawrenceadjah.com/): Pastor, builder and speaker. Building the infrastructure human belonging requires.
- [About](https://lawrenceadjah.com/about): Harvard, Stanford, UT Austin and Gordon-Conwell. McKinsey to ministry. The full biography, credentials and boards.
- [Books](https://lawrenceadjah.com/books): A complete narration of the Bible, and a curriculum for the conversations most couples never have.
- [The 100 Marriage](https://lawrenceadjah.com/the100marriagebook): Decisions and declarations you need to make before getting married. The best-selling curriculum for surfacing the unspoken.
- [The 100 Marriage: Arranged](https://lawrenceadjah.com/the-100-marriage-arranged): The arranged marriage process: a guided, communal path to marriage rooted in aligned expectations and biblical counsel, built on The 100 Marriage Assessment. Not matchmaking, not dating.
- [Lawrence E. Adjah Reads the Bible: NIV — Audiobook](https://lawrenceadjah.com/audiobook): The complete Bible, Old and New Testament, in the New International Version. #1 new release on Amazon and Audible.
- [Speaking engagements](https://lawrenceadjah.com/speaking): Universities, churches, corporations and conferences. Signature talks on loneliness, belonging and building a life while building a career.
- [Invite Lawrence](https://lawrenceadjah.com/request): Preaching, keynotes, panels, counseling and officiating. Response within two business days.
- [Sermons & talks](https://lawrenceadjah.com/sermons): Preaching, keynotes and conversations, each linking to the video or the podcast episode.
- [Articles & writings](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles): Essays by Lawrence E. Adjah on faith, grief, love, prayer, purpose and belonging — 13 short pieces written along the way, 2021–2024.
- [Projects](https://lawrenceadjah.com/projects): Social infrastructure for human flourishing: the initiative, the 5C methodology, and the products and software built on top.
- [Social Infrastructure Initiative](https://lawrenceadjah.com/partner): The case, the structural pivot, the studio portfolio, and every way to partner with the Family Dinner Foundation.
- [Press](https://lawrenceadjah.com/press): Coverage of the work: the loneliness crisis, building belonging at scale, and the case for gathering people around a table.
- [Media](https://lawrenceadjah.com/media): Press kit, biography, the Watch God Work podcast, and sermons and talks. Everything a producer or host needs.

## Articles

- [Children of God, America is Playing with Fire.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/children-of-god-america-is-playing-with-fire): A reflection on the current state of our nation, our identity as salt and light, and practical ways to move in godliness during volatile times.
- [God is Always Speaking to You](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/god-is-always-speaking-to-you): An encouragement to listen for God's voice in every aspect of life, from creation and Scripture to our own bodies and circumstances.
- [How to Keep Your Heart Warm in an Increasingly Cold World](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/how-to-keep-your-heart-warm): A reflection on protecting your heart from the growing wickedness and frigidity of the world through the power of faith and intentional practice.
- [Why You Need to Learn How to Love 'Today' More than 'Tomorrow'](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/how-to-love-today-more-than-tomorrow): A call to stop putting off the important matters of the heart and to embrace the grace of the present moment.
- [Why You Need to Learn How to Pray on the Spot](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/how-to-pray-on-the-spot): A brief encouragement and prayer on the power of immediate, audible prayer in our daily relationships and encounters.
- [Living (with) Grief: It is possible to grieve the living, too.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/living-with-grief): A reflection on the phenomena of grieving the living and finding the strength to move forward while carrying the weight of loss.
- [On Settling. And Black Men.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/on-settling-and-black-men): A challenging reflection on the concept of 'settling' in relationships and the inherent value of every human being as an image-bearer of God.
- [Success by God's Standards](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/success-by-gods-standards): A reflection on the long-term impact of our work and how divine success is often measured by the seeds we plant for future generations.
- [The Gospel Case for Black Love.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/the-gospel-case-for-black-love): A gospel-centered discussion on the redemptive power and spiritual significance of Black Love in a world of racial division.
- [Why You Need to Remind Yourself Right Now: It's Not About You.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/why-it-is-not-about-you): A reflection on shifting our perspective and realizing that most conflicts and distances are not personal, but a result of others dealing with life.
- [Why You Shouldn't Ignore Your Dreams](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/why-you-shouldnt-ignore-your-dreams): Understanding how God uses dreams to speak to us and the importance of discerning the dreams He wants us to pursue.
- [Why You (Still) Need to Believe in Miracles](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/why-you-still-need-to-believe-in-miracles): A call to maintain high expectations for divine intervention, even when we have experienced disappointment.
- [You are the Father: Why Being a Parent is Not a Choice but a Call for Everyone.](https://lawrenceadjah.com/articles/you-are-the-father-why-being-a-parent-is-not-a-choice): Exploring the universal call to parenthood and how we can all serve as spiritual and communal fathers and mothers.

## Related organizations

- [Family Dinner Foundation](https://ourfamilydinner.org/): the organization Lawrence founded and leads as Founder and CEO; canonical source for its programs and impact.
- [5C Mutual Care Framework](https://ourfamilydinner.org/5c-mutual-care-framework/): the definitive description of the framework. lawrenceadjah.com summarizes it and links here rather than duplicating it.
- [The 100 Marriage Assessment](https://the100marriage.lawrenceadjah.com/): the compatibility assessment underneath the book and the arranged marriage process.
